column1: # tests/rulecheck/recurrence.tsv — the ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS of tools/recurrence_alarm.py (#271, 14z-199; the rot rule the maintainer adopted):
# a rule-checker finding that recurs (a question plus a pair of cited tokens, in 3 or more subjects across 2 or more
# sessions) fails the close's standing check `recurrence_alarm` until a row here names the ticket that owns its cause.
# A row covers the occurrences in runs up to and including its through-run-id; later ones count afresh, so a fix that
# does not hold raises the alarm again. The ticket must have a row in docs/project/tickets.tsv. Rows are added, never
# widened silently: a new through-run-id is a new judgement, written with its reason.
# Columns: question<TAB>tokens (space-separated; the row covers every pair of them)<TAB>#N<TAB>through-run-id<TAB>note
